checks.title: Users must have unique IDs
checks.description: Ensures there are no duplicate user IDs in the data set.
checks.condition: len(ctx['users']) == len(set(u['id'] for u in ctx['users']))

checks.title: Users must be adults (18+)
checks.description: All users must be 18 or older.

checks.title: At least one active user exists
checks.description: There should be at least one active user.
checks.condition: any(u.get('active', False) for u in ctx['users'])
checks.error: Attribute calls are not allowed; use allowed helpers or inline expressions.
